StaffȱReportȱȱ ȱ ȱ AgendaȱItem:ȱȱHȱ–ȱ3ȱ
ȱ
DATE:ȱȱ Aprilȱ16,ȱ2025ȱȱ ȱ ȱ ȱ ȱ (Aprilȱ22,ȱ2025ȱMeeting)ȱ
TO:ȱȱ BoardȱofȱDirectorsȱ
FROM:ȱ PrincipalȱEngineer,ȱRobȱHillebrechtȱ
SUBJECT:ȱ EngineeringȱServicesȱMonthlyȱStatusȱReportȱ
ȱ
BestȱRoadȱMutualȱConsolidationȱ
SpecialtyȱConstructionȱInc.ȱ(SCI)ȱbeganȱconstructionȱonȱtheȱJohnȱSmithȱRoadȱPipelineȱtheȱfirstȱ
weekȱofȱAprilȱandȱareȱonȱscheduleȱtoȱcompleteȱinstallationȱofȱthatȱwaterȱmainȱbyȱmidȬMay.ȱAllȱtheȱ
partsȱandȱmaterialsȱforȱtheȱWellȱ#5ȱImprovementsȱhaveȱbeenȱorderedȱandȱSCIȱintendsȱtoȱcompleteȱ
thoseȱimprovementsȱbyȱearlyȱJune.ȱSunnyslopeȱexecutedȱaȱcontractȱwithȱCalconȱforȱPLCȱandȱ
instrumentationȱelectronicsȱandȱSCADAȱprogrammingȱthatȱisȱrequiredȱforȱeffectiveȱoperationȱofȱ
theȱconsolidatedȱBestȱRoadȱMutualȱsystem.ȱSunnyslopeȱstaffȱalsoȱpressureȱtestedȱandȱdisinfectedȱ
theȱoldȱSBCWDȱpipelineȱfromȱWellȱ5ȱtoȱFairviewȱRoadȱwhichȱweȱwillȱbeȱutilizingȱtoȱsupplyȱwaterȱ
fromȱWellȱ5ȱtoȱtheȱFoxhillȱZone.ȱTheȱannexationȱofȱtheȱBestȱRoadȱMutualȱserviceȱareaȱintoȱ
Sunnyslope’sȱboundaryȱisȱprogressingȱwellȱwithȱLAFCOȱandȱexpectedȱtoȱbeȱcompletedȱonȱtime.ȱ
SignaturesȱareȱbeingȱcollectedȱfromȱallȱBestȱRoadȱMutual’sȱcustomersȱindicatingȱthatȱtheyȱacceptȱ
Sunnyslope’sȱratesȱsoȱthatȱaȱPropȱ218ȱprocessȱisȱnotȱrequired.ȱ
ȱ
VentureȱEstates,ȱTresȱPinos,ȱ&ȱStonegateȱMegaȬGrantȱConsolidationȱ
EngineeringȱstaffȱhaveȱcontinuedȱtoȱworkȱcloselyȱwithȱWallaceȱGroupȱtoȱprogressȱtheȱplansȱforȱtheȱ
MegaȬGrantȱConsolidation.ȱWallaceȱGroupȱhiredȱLTECȱtoȱconductȱpotholeȱinvestigationȱofȱ
existingȱburiedȱutilitiesȱalongȱtheȱproposedȱpathwayȱofȱtheȱnewȱwaterȱpipelines.ȱSunnyslopeȱstaffȱ
areȱcoordinatingȱwithȱLTECȱandȱtheȱsmallȱwaterȱsystemsȱtoȱlocateȱtheirȱexistingȱwaterȱpipesȱandȱ
adjustȱtheȱnewȱpipeline’sȱdesignȱtoȱavoidȱthem.ȱForȱtheȱpipelineȱsegmentȱthroughȱtheȱfutureȱ
FairviewȱCornersȱPhaseȱ2,ȱRJAȱisȱwellȱintoȱtheȱdesign.ȱSeveralȱmeetingsȱhaveȱbeenȱheldȱwithȱthemȱ
toȱreviseȱtheȱdraftȱplansȱandȱexpediteȱtheȱprocessȱtoȱmeetȱtheȱMayȱ31,ȱ2025ȱdeadline.ȱAȱcontractȱ
hasȱbeenȱexecutedȱwithȱBRIȱforȱeasementȱappraisalsȱforȱtheȱseveralȱeasementsȱthatȱmustȱbeȱ
acquiredȱfromȱprivateȱpropertyȱownersȱforȱtheȱconsolidationȱproject.ȱAppraisalsȱareȱexpectedȱtoȱ
beȱcompletedȱbyȱmidȬMayȱatȱwhichȱpointȱSunnyslopeȱwillȱbeginȱnegotiationsȱwithȱowners.ȱ
WallaceȱGroupȱwillȱbeȱsubmittingȱaȱgrantȱscopeȱamendmentȱtoȱDWRȱtoȱallowȱforȱupsizingȱ
additionalȱpipeȱthroughȱStonegateȱdueȱtoȱmodelingȱresultsȱwhichȱindicateȱinadequateȱflowȱ
capacityȱtoȱreliablyȱfillȱtheȱStonegateȱTankȱafterȱfireȱflowsȱorȱmaximumȱdayȱdemands.ȱThisȱcouldȱ
requireȱinstallingȱ1ȱtoȱ2ȱmilesȱofȱnewȱpipeȱinȱStonegateȱandȱFoxhillȱCircle.ȱWithȱtheȱannexationȱofȱ
StonegateȱandȱTresȱPinos,ȱsomeȱadditionalȱpropertiesȱareȱbeingȱconsideredȱforȱannexationȱbasedȱ
onȱcurrentlyȱreceivingȱoutȬofȬboundaryȱserviceȱfromȱTresȱPinosȱWaterȱDistrict,ȱpreventingȱislandsȱ
withinȱSunnyslope’sȱboundary,ȱorȱtoȱbetterȱmaintainȱcontiguousnessȱofȱSunnyslope’sȱboundary.ȱ
